channel.title: Ship Index Grow — Blog
channel.description: Practical guides on building products with AI, getting found in Google and AI search (SEO/GEO), launching and automating growth. From the Ship Index Grow school.

item.title: You Shipped Your AI-Built App. Now What? How to Get Your First 100 Users
item.description: Vibe-coded an app and nobody signs up? A practical, free plan to find your first 100 users: direct outreach, communities, launch platforms, SEO pages and proof content.

item.title: Security Checklist Before You Launch an AI-Built App
item.description: AI coding tools ship fast and leak secrets just as fast. A plain-language security checklist for vibe-coded apps: API keys, database access rules, auth, payments, forms and backups.

item.title: Why Google Isn't Indexing Your New Site, and How to Fix It
item.description: New website not showing in Google? What 'Discovered' and 'Crawled – currently not indexed' mean in Search Console, the common causes, and a free step-by-step fix.

item.title: How to Build and Launch a Product with AI in 6 Weeks: The 2026 Playbook
item.description: A week-by-week plan to go from idea to a live, indexed product with AI coding tools: validation, UX, AI-assisted build, deploy, SEO/GEO and first users.

item.title: GEO in 2026: How to Get Your Product Cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI
item.description: Generative engine optimization explained: how AI search picks sources, and a practical checklist to make your site crawlable, quotable and cited by AI assistants.

item.title: AI Agents for Solo Founders: What to Automate After Launch, and What Not To
item.description: A practical guide to AI agents and workflow automation for small products: which tasks to automate first, how to keep a human in the loop, and free tools to start with.
